business_summary: CONOCOPHILLIPS (NYSE: COP) explores for, produces, transports and markets crude oil, bitumen, natural gas, NGLs and LNG worldwide. It carries 2 chain/link placement(s): russian-diesel-ban/crude-feedstock (OVER_CROWDED, not money_corner); hormuz-maritime/non-gulf-energy-substitution (CROWDED, not money_corner). Fundamentals this run: latest fiscal-year revenue 51,824,000,000, -5.31% 3-year revenue CAGR.

exposure_summary.narrative: ConocoPhillips has 2 placement(s): russian-diesel-ban/crude-feedstock, scored OVER_CROWDED by the chain's own heat map (the heavy sour barrel this chain converts is abundant, fungible and already priced, per the link's own bottleneck note); and hormuz-maritime/non-gulf-energy-substitution, a diversified non-OPEC producer role, scored CROWDED. No chain-specific or link-specific revenue percentage is disclosed or sourced for this issuer; only company-wide fundamentals are available.
